concrete_pour.name: Concrete pour
concrete_pour.formwork_dimensions: Formwork position, dimensions and levels match the drawings
concrete_pour.formwork_tight: Formwork tight, braced and cleaned; release agent applied
concrete_pour.rebar_accepted: Reinforcement inspected and accepted before the pour
concrete_pour.cover_spacers: Cover spacers in place for the specified concrete cover
concrete_pour.embedded_items: Embedded items, sleeves and conduits fixed in position
concrete_pour.mix_ticket: Delivery tickets match the specified mix (strength class, slump, maximum aggregate size)
concrete_pour.slump_test: Slump test on site within tolerance
concrete_pour.test_samples: Test cylinders or cubes taken and labelled
concrete_pour.placing_compaction: Concrete placed and vibrated without segregation or cold joints

rebar.name: Reinforcement
rebar.bar_size_spacing: Bar sizes, number and spacing match the shop drawings
rebar.mill_certificates: Mill certificates for the delivered steel are on file
rebar.laps_anchorage: Lap lengths, anchorages and hooks as specified
rebar.cover: Cover to reinforcement as specified (spacers and chairs)
rebar.ties_secure: Bars tied and fixed so they cannot move during the pour
rebar.bars_clean: Bars free of loose rust, oil, mud and release agent
rebar.starter_bars: Starter bars and dowels for the next lift in position

structural_steel.name: Structural steel
structural_steel.member_sizes: Member sizes and grades match the drawings and mill certificates
structural_steel.bolts_tightened: High-strength bolts installed and tightened by the specified method
structural_steel.welds_visual: Welds visually inspected: size and length correct, no cracks or undercut
structural_steel.welds_ndt: Non-destructive testing of complete-penetration welds done and accepted
structural_steel.plumb_alignment: Columns plumb and members aligned within tolerance
structural_steel.coating: Primer and fire protection coating applied to the specified thickness

mep_rough_in.name: MEP rough-in
mep_rough_in.routing_coordinated: Routing matches the coordinated MEP drawings; clearances kept
mep_rough_in.supports_hangers: Supports and hangers at the specified spacing
mep_rough_in.penetrations_sealed: Penetrations through walls and slabs sleeved and sealed, fire-stopped where rated
mep_rough_in.pressure_test: Pipework pressure test held for the specified time without loss
mep_rough_in.insulation_resistance: Cable insulation resistance and continuity tested
mep_rough_in.access_kept: Access kept to valves, dampers and junction boxes

waterproofing.name: Waterproofing
waterproofing.substrate_ready: Substrate clean, dry, sound and primed
waterproofing.membrane_laps: Membrane laps, upstands and terminations as specified
waterproofing.details_sealed: Drains, penetrations and corners detailed and sealed
waterproofing.flood_test: Flood test held for 24 to 48 hours without leaks
waterproofing.protection_layer: Protection layer placed before backfill or screed

fire_stopping.name: Fire stopping
fire_stopping.system_listed: Fire-stopping system is a tested system for this penetration and rating
fire_stopping.annular_gap: Annular gap and sealant depth as the system requires
fire_stopping.penetration_labels: Each penetration labelled with its system and installer
fire_stopping.fire_doors: Fire doors close and latch; seals and closers fitted
fire_stopping.detection_alarm: Detectors and alarm devices installed and tested

finishes.name: Finishes
finishes.surfaces_flat: Walls and ceilings flat and plumb within tolerance, no visible defects
finishes.paint_uniform: Paint even in colour and sheen; no runs, patches or stains
finishes.tiles_sound: Tiles level with even joints; no hollow tiles on a tap test
finishes.doors_windows: Doors and windows open, close and lock properly
finishes.sealants: Sealant around wet areas and frames continuous
finishes.area_clean: Area cleaned and protective films removed
